get_model_flops_count: get the total FLOPs count for a given model and input data
review_get_flops_profile: review the get_flops_profile function that uses FlopsProfiler to profile model compute
refactor_get_flops_profile: refactor get_flops_profile to support batched input or multiple forward passes
